schema_donor.usage: RBDSeries and RBDSeriesStructure table schemas only; RBDBridge schema is transcribed from the installed dictionary, not this donor

source.rule: A bridge has UL, LL, BR, UR and LR blocks and operates when any of UL+UR, UL+BR+LR, LL+LR or LL+BR+UR is functional. The bridge does not support online replacement or direct repair.

configuration.physical: Same system with five installed positions POS-A/B/C/D/E, each with one TEACH-LRU-01. Only accepted parent POS-A and POS-B retain configured failure modes and half-hour direct system CM routes; C/D/E have no configured failure mode.
configuration.bridge_arm: System G04-OPS points to G07-BRIDGE with UL=B, LL=C, BR=E, UR=D, LR=A, all in G04-OPS. After B and A failures, LL+BR+UR is the only functioning bridge path.
configuration.routes_arm: Same five physical positions. System series root requires healthy E and a 1-of-2 active parallel of upper series B+D and lower series C+A. The control has no diagonal BR route.
configuration.mission: One fixed 26-hour mission scheduled h8–34; all other parent mission and report controls unchanged.

exact_delta: Both arms add identical healthy physical positions D/E and their operational-mode rows. The pair varies only RBD topology and description; failure modes, CM, mission, seed and controls remain identical. E is included in the routes control as a healthy series member to keep all five positions in the RBD.
pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms import, roundtrip and calculate with zero converter errors and only reviewed diagnostics.

B first fails noncritically in both. A next fails while LL=C, BR=E and UR=D remain healthy; the bridge arm stays operational through the diagonal path, whereas the two ordinary routes are both broken and the routes arm aborts.

First B and A failure times/identities match across arms before outcome divergence, and individual events reconcile with 72-bin reports. If random draws differ, only observed matched prefix may support comparison.
native_acceptance: Two unique guarded session-0 SSH runs with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration and frozen source/raw SHA-256 seals.
Both arms: exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Matched B/A failures with healthy C/D/E and opposite second-failure criticality/mission result attributable to the four-path bridge rule, or diagnostic classification if the hypothesis fails.
Independent read-only replay of source, raw seals, events and reports apart from author implementation.
diagnostic_gate: If either converter rejects the model, event draws diverge before the proposed diagonal contrast, or the bridge fails to salvage the B/A combination, preserve the runs as diagnostic and revise under a new candidate version/run IDs. Do not infer bridge semantics from source alone.
limits: One bridge path combination, one mode, seed and replication; this is not a full four-path truth table or population reliability estimate.
No online maintenance, nested bridge, GUI RBD visual or cross-engine claim.
